subject: maths
question:
What is the median of the following distribution?

 
 

 
 
 
 

 Class
 
 
 
 
 140-190
 190-240
 240-290
 290-340
 340-390
 
 

 Frequency
 14
 37
 28
 39
 12
solution:
**Given:**

Class intervals: 140-190, 190-240, 240-290, 290-340, 340-390

Frequencies: 14, 37, 28, 39, 12

**Formula used:**

Median Class Formula: Median = L + ((frac{N)/(2) - CF}{f} ) times h

Where:

L = Lower boundary of the median class

N = Total frequency

CF = Cumulative frequency before the median class

f = Frequency of the median class

h = Class width

**Calculation:**

N (Total frequency) = 14 + 37 + 28 + 39 + 12 = 130

N/2 = 130 / 2 = 65

Cumulative frequencies:

140-190: 14

190-240: 14 + 37 = 51

240-290: 51 + 28 = 79

290-340: 79 + 39 = 118

340-390: 118 + 12 = 130

The cumulative frequency just greater than 65 is 79. Therefore, the median class is 240-290.

L = 240 (lower boundary of the median class)

CF = 51 (cumulative frequency before the median class)

f = 28 (frequency of the median class)

h = 50 (class width)

⇒ Median = 240 + ((65 - 51) / 28) × 50

⇒ Median = 240 + (14 / 28) × 50

⇒ Median = 240 + 0.5 × 50

⇒ Median = 240 + 25

⇒ Median = 265

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
